namespaceNote: The unit attribute is NamespacePreset (Filling / Dosing). Objects created through Openness got Namespace ""; the Namespace attribute was set with om_set on Filling.UDT_FillRecipe, Filling.FB_Filler, Filling.FC_FillHelper, Dosing.FB_Doser, Dosing.IDB_Doser and Dosing.OB_Dosing (Step 2). safety.acceptance: Not accepted. The safety program must be verified and accepted by a qualified person before any use; the corpus is never downloaded.
safety.note: TIA created a default group 'F-runtime group 1' (main safety block Main_Safety_RTG1, F_FBD) with the F-CPU. Its Name and MainSafetyBlockName are read-only in Openness, so it was deleted and RTG1 created with an F-LAD main safety FB; TIA reused FOB_RTG1 and RTG1SysInfo. The unused Main_Safety_RTG1 and Main_Safety_RTG1_DB were deleted.
